data.display_address: Residences 15, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Located in the prestigious District One, this exceptional three-bedroom residence with maid’s room offers an outstanding combination of space, luxury, privacy, and breathtaking views.

Positioned on the ground floor, the apartment boasts the largest layout within the residence, complemented by an expansive terrace that enhances the indoor–outdoor living experience. This remarkable outdoor area opens directly onto the stunning Crystal Lagoon and provides uninterrupted views of the iconic Burj Khalifa.

The residence is fully furnished with high-quality furniture, blending contemporary elegance with exceptional comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the living spaces with natural light, while all three bedrooms feature direct access to the terrace, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living and allowing residents to step outside at any time.

In addition, the apartment includes a separate maid’s room, spacious living areas, and a thoughtfully designed layout that maximizes both functionality and comfort.

Residents of District One benefit from a secure gated community that ensures privacy and safety. The area is known for its lush green landscapes, cycling and jogging tracks, and the spectacular crystal lagoon — offering a resort-style lifestyle just minutes from Downtown Dubai.

This residence represents a rare opportunity to enjoy lagoon-front living, enhanced by the largest layout and direct terrace access from all bedrooms, within one of Dubai’s most exclusive communities.
